display.purpose: The scan-every-tray promise at the top of the workspace.

headline.purpose: Scanner, result, and pattern section headings.

editorial.purpose: The single humanizing supporting line beneath the display headline.

shadows.name: header-separation
shadows.purpose: Subtle separation for the sticky identity bar only.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Short color/background transitions for controls and affordances.

motion.name: receipt-settle
motion.purpose: Settles a new result receipt into place without theatrical motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Collapse transitions and animation for operators who request reduced motion.

components.name: Station Header
components.description: Sticky identity/status strip with the MottainAI mark, station context, and scan count.
components.html: MottainAITray return station4 scans
components.css: .ds-station-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; min-height: 64px; padding: 12px 24px; background: var(--pure-white); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); box-shadow: 0 3px 9px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.03); font-family: var(--font-inter), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink-black); } .ds-wordmark { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.03em; color: var(--midnight-ink); } .ds-station-context { margin-left: auto; color: var(--stone); font-size: 14px; } .ds-count { border-radius: 9999px; padding: 6px 12px; background: var(--sky-tint); color: var(--notion-blue); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-station-header { padding-inline: 16px; } .ds-station-context { display: none; } }

components.name: Primary Capture Action
components.description: Filled cobalt action for an immediate operator intervention such as Analyze now.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; padding: 8px 16px; background: var(--notion-blue); color: var(--pure-white); font-family: var(--font-inter), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--notion-blue-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--notion-blue) 34%, transparent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Recovery Action
components.description: Quiet bordered action for recalibration and recovery paths.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 9px; padding: 8px 12px; background: var(--pure-white); color: var(--graphite); font-family: var(--font-inter), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--paper-warmth); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--notion-blue) 34%, transparent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Capture Mode Tabs
components.description: Two-option segmented control that switches between upload fallback and live camera.
components.css: .ds-mode-tabs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 4px; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--paper-deep); font-family: var(--font-inter), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-mode-tab { min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 12px; background: transparent; color: var(--stone); font-size: 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-mode-tab:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 70%); color: var(--charcoal); } .ds-mode-tab-active { background: var(--pure-white); color: var(--notion-blue); } .ds-mode-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--notion-blue) 34%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ready Status Chip
components.description: Compact semantic status for a scanner that is ready to receive the next tray.
components.html: Ready for next tray
components.css: .ds-status-ready { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 6px 12px; background: var(--success-tint); color: var(--success); font-family: var(--font-inter), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-status-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--success); }

components.name: Capture Dropzone
components.description: Large dashed upload target that keeps the photo fallback explicit and calm.
components.css: .ds-dropzone { display: flex; min-height: 260px; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; border: 2px dashed color-mix(in srgb, var(--stone) 45%, transparent); border-radius: 12px; padding: 40px 24px; background: var(--paper-warmth); color: var(--stone); font-family: var(--font-inter), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 160ms ease, background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-dropzone:hover, .ds-dropzone:focus-within { border-color: var(--notion-blue); background: var(--sky-tint); } .ds-dropzone strong { color: var(--ink-black); font-size: 16px; } .ds-dropzone input { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; opacity: 0; }

components.name: Latest Result Rail
components.description: Receipt-like latest result surface for dish, waste, confidence, reasoning, and in-rail errors.
components.html:
Latest scan

Immediate feedback for the tray at your station.

09:13 AM
The scan could not be completed.Retry the scan or switch capture modes.

Ready for the first tray
components.css: .ds-result-rail { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex-direction: column; gap: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px; background: var(--pure-white); color: var(--ink-black); font-family: var(--font-inter), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-result-heading { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding-bottom: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-result-heading h2 { margin: 0; color: var(--midnight-ink); font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-result-heading p, .ds-result-heading time { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--stone); font-size: 14px; } .ds-result-error { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 30%, transparent); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; background: var(--danger-tint); color: var(--danger); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-result-placeholder { margin: 0; border: 1px dashed color-mix(in srgb, var(--stone) 40%, transparent); border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px 20px; background: var(--paper-warmth); color: var(--midnight-ink); font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Detection Image
components.description: Evidence image with thin semantic detection boxes for plate/tray and leftover food.
components.css: .ds-detection-image { position: relative; min-height: 180px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--paper-deep); } .ds-plate-box, .ds-leftover-box { position: absolute; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-plate-box { inset: 18% 14% 16% 12%; border: 1px dashed var(--success); } .ds-leftover-box { inset: 42% 28% 22% 34%; border: 1px solid var(--marigold); background: rgb(255 177 16 / 15%); } .ds-plate-box span, .ds-leftover-box span { position: absolute; top: -18px; left: 0; padding: 1px 4px; background: var(--success); color: var(--pure-white); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-leftover-box span { background: var(--marigold); color: var(--midnight-ink); }

narrative.overview:
MottainAI is an Operate-mode instrument for the tray-return station, not a marketing dashboard. Its visual language turns a potentially hectic handoff into a calm, repeatable bench routine: warm paper under the work, white hairline surfaces for the active tools, and one unmistakable blue action when the operator needs to intervene. The implementation and the shipped desktop/mobile rasters are the source of truth; there is no approved external comp to imitate.

The system is compact and workmanlike. Inter carries the operational UI, while Source Serif 4 adds a human editorial note to the short supporting message under the headline. Tonal color fields identify ready, analyzing, success, warning, and error states without turning the station into a rainbow. Depth comes from paper-to-surface contrast and hairline borders, not floating cards or decorative chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Warm-paper canvas with white, flat, hairline containers.
Scanner-first asymmetric workspace: camera/capture occupies two-thirds on desktop; the latest result occupies the right rail.
Cobalt is the sole filled primary action; state accents stay sparse and semantic.
Immediate result feedback is a receipt-like rail; analysis errors remain inside that rail.
Mobile stacks the same sequence: scanner, action/state, latest result, then patterns/history.

rules.name: The Warm Paper Rule
rules.body: Keep the station grounded on warm paper; white surfaces are tools laid on top of it, never glossy floating objects.

rules.name: The One Blue Action Rule
rules.body: Use Station Cobalt for the action the operator should take next. Do not compete with it using multiple filled button colors.

rules.name: The Workhorse Type Rule
rules.body: Keep operational labels in Inter; reserve Source Serif 4 for the single supporting editorial line, not controls or status copy.

rules.name: The Early-Wrap Rule
rules.body: Let the display promise wrap naturally on narrow screens rather than shrinking it into a poster-like single line.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Do not add card shadows, gradients, glass, or decorative chrome; use tonal layering, borders, and state fields to communicate hierarchy.

dos: Do make the scanner and its next action unmistakably primary in every responsive layout.
Do use Warm Paper, Pure White, hairlines, and flat tonal fields before reaching for decoration.
Do keep cobalt reserved for primary action and active capture emphasis; use semantic accents for status and waste data.
Do preserve the mobile order of scanner, result rail, then patterns/history.
Do keep analysis errors in the latest-result rail, where the operator is already looking for feedback.
Do use the development-only query previews for visual review without adding a visible mock-state selector to the product UI.
Do support reduced motion; receipt-settle is a restrained 320ms settle, not a persistent animation.
donts: Don't turn the page into an equal-column analytics dashboard or let patterns outrank the current scan.
Don't add gradients, glassmorphism, decorative chrome, or content shadows.
Don't use multiple competing filled action colors.
Don't expose query-only preview fixtures as a production control or imply that scan results persist beyond the browser tab.
Don't move capture errors into a separate lower row; the result rail owns analysis feedback.
Don't fabricate a canonical approved comp: the shipped code and finish-review rasters are the visual authority until a new direction is explicitly chosen.
